title: Carbs from Calculator are not recorded
body:
Reporting bugs -------------- - **Note the precise time the problem occurred** and describe the circumstances and steps that caused the problem - Note the Build version (found in the About dialog in the app, when pressing the three dots in the upper-right corner). On Oct 15 at 1339, bolus was calculated for 100g carbs using the Calculator on AAPS. After hitting "OK" on the Calculator screen, bolus was delivered in its totality. However, the 100g carbs were never recorded in the Treatments page, nor did they show up as COB on the Overview page. AAPS 3.3.1.3, Build: dece928837-2025.01.30 Log file: [CondensedAndroidAPS._2025-10-15_14-01-32_.5.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22965885/CondensedAndroidAPS._2025-10-15_14-01-32_.5.txt)
Screenshot of Bolus given but carbs not recorded
Screenshot of 1339 Calculator Results

comments.body: sorry, support is provided only on latest master and dev. Update and re-test
